BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preferred drug substitutions; and amending RCW69.41.190.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.41.190 and 2003 1st sp.s. c 29 s 5 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Nonpreferred drug" means all other drugs in the sametherapeutic class as any preferred drug. (b) "Preferred drug" means any drug that is preferred pursuant toan evidencebased prescription drug program established under RCW70.14.050. (2) Any pharmacist filling a prescription under a state purchasedhealth care program as defined in RCW 41.05.011(2) shall substitute,where identified, a preferred drug for any nonpreferred drug in a giventherapeutic class, unless the endorsing practitioner has indicated onthe prescription that the nonpreferred drug must be dispensed aswritten, or the prescription is for a refill of an antipsychotic, p. 1 HB 2995antidepressant, chemotherapy, antiretroviral, or immunosuppressivedrug, in which case the pharmacist shall dispense the prescribednonpreferred drug. (((2))) (3) When a substitution is made under subsection (((1)))(2) of this section, the dispensing pharmacist shall notify theprescribing practitioner of the specific drug and dose dispensed.
